# ASK Security

> Independent security audits for web3 protocols, infrastructure, and wallets — from code review to 24/7 post-deployment monitoring. Ship with confidence.

## Services

- [Code Audit](https://asksecurity.io/#services): line-by-line review of smart contracts and off-chain code (Solidity, Rust, zk-circuits), with fix verification.
- [Infrastructure Audit](https://asksecurity.io/#services): nodes, validators, bridges, and cloud setups reviewed end to end.
- [Security Research](https://asksecurity.io/#services): adversarial research on novel mechanisms, with proof-of-concept exploits.
- [Post-Deployment Monitoring](https://asksecurity.io/#services): 24/7 on-chain monitoring, real-time alerts, and incident response.
